messages:
Priya Nair: Hey team, Priya here — joining as a Product Designer today. Two quick things: I can't install the Figma plugin we use for tokens (it prompts for org admin approval) and wondering where we keep recordings of past research sessions?
Tom Becker: Welcome Priya! :tada: For plugins we have a process: request in #eng-security with the plugin link + why we need it. @Ruth handles approvals for Design.
Ruth Evans: Hi Priya :wave: I'll take a look. Can you paste the plugin name? Some plugins are blocked due to data exfil risk. If it's the "TokenSync" plugin, we had to whitelist a specific client id.
Priya Nair: It's called TokenSync Pro (from the Figma community). I use it to sync tokens into design files.
Liam O'Connor: FYI, security requires a short risk blurb: what scopes it needs and any external storage. If TokenSync has an external backend, we might ask them for a privacy/data flow doc.
Priya Nair: Got it — TokenSync asks for read/write to files and calls home for versioning. I'll draft the blurb. Also, where are research recordings stored? I want to watch last quarter's usability tests for context.
Tom Becker: We moved recordings into the Research Archive (Notion) last year: Product > Research Archive -> Recordings. If you don't have Notion perms, ping me and I'll add you. There's also a short index with topics and timestamps.
Ruth Evans: I approved TokenSync for the "design-sandbox" projects pre-approval, but for org-level install I need the security blurb + the plugin manifest URL. Once you post here I'll kick it off.
Priya Nair: Posted the manifest URL and a short blurb in #eng-security (https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/REDACTED). Thanks — also curious about our critique cadence. Is there a regular design critique we should join?
Liam O'Connor: Design critique meets Wednesdays 4pm (biweekly) — calendar is in the Product group calendar. New designers usually present a 10-min show-and-tell in their second week.
Priya Nair: Perfect. One more: we have an old token set in "Old Tokens - DO NOT USE" file. Who owns the migration plan to the new tokens system? I don't want to accidentally push breaking changes.
Ruth Evans: Design Systems owns the migration. We have a migration playbook in the Design System Figma file and a Notion migration tracker (Design System -> Token Migrations). I'll add you as a watcher on that tracker.
Priya Nair: Thanks! I've requested plugin approval and Notion access. Appreciate the fast responses.
design-bot: :white_check_mark: Welcome package: Priya Nair added to Product Designers. Action items created: request plugin approval, join #design-system, watch Research Archive.
Priya Nair: Thanks all — will go through the recordings and join the critique next week.
